salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when people need to walk into a room, connect a laptop or room source, and get content onto the display without cable swapping or technical confusion.

governedSpecification.productType: Essentials 4x1 8K60 HDMI 2.1 switcher with audio de-embed and ARC

ports.detail: Audio de-embed from HDMI or ARC, up to 5.1

dependencies: HDMI output only - no HDBaseT; a remote display needs an HDMI 2.1-rated extender
8K / HDMI 2.1 end-to-end requires HDMI 2.1 cabling and a 2.1 display; use S/PDIF de-embed or ARC to feed a non-2.1 audio system
checks: HDMI-only switcher (single HDMI output, no HDBaseT). Do NOT pair a bare HDBaseT receiver with it - for a remote display add an HDMI 2.1-rated extender.
8K60 output is 4:2:0 10bit; full 4:4:4 10bit tops out at 4K120. Confirm the exact 8K chroma/refresh the display needs.
10K@120Hz is via DSC 1.2a (an HDMI 2.1-approved compression), not native uncompressed.
RS-232 control is on the 4x1 (EXP-SW-0401-8K) model only; the 2x1 has none.
warnings: 8K60 output is 4:2:0 10bit, not 4:4:4. The full-bandwidth 4:4:4 ceiling is 4K120.
HDMI output only - in a distributed design an HDMI 2.1-rated extender must be added; the switcher alone will not reach a remote zone.
